args.query: FastAPI OAuth2 password flow login that issues JWT access tokens and protects routes

results.title: FastAPI OAuth2 password flow with PyJWT tokens and scope checks
results.summary: OAuth2 password login issuing PyJWT access tokens, Argon2 hashes via pwdlib, and per-route scope checks with SecurityScopes, tested offline with TestClient.

results.title: FastAPI + PyJWT bearer auth
results.summary: OAuth2 password flow in FastAPI issuing PyJWT tokens, with a current-user dependency guarding routes.

results.title: FastAPI login with argon2-cffi hashing and rehash checks
results.summary: A form-based FastAPI login that verifies argon2id hashes without leaking which users exist, and transparently upgrades outdated hashes on successful login, tested offline with TestClient and an in-memory store.

results.title: Flask 3 + Flask-JWT-Extended access and refresh tokens
results.summary: Login, protected routes, refresh tokens and custom claims in Flask 3 using Flask-JWT-Extended, with an app factory.

results.title: FastAPI routes wired to a dependency-injector DeclarativeContainer, tested offline
results.summary: Build a DeclarativeContainer with Configuration, Singleton and Factory providers, wire it into FastAPI routes with @inject and Depends(Provide[...]), and test it in-process with httpx.ASGITransport.

results.title: FastAPI lifespan state tested with httpx ASGITransport and asgi-lifespan
results.summary: A FastAPI app that opens a SQLite connection in its lifespan, then test it offline through httpx ASGITransport, with asgi-lifespan running startup and shutdown.

results.title: FastAPI + Pydantic v2 validators, discriminated unions and serializers
results.summary: Pydantic v2 patterns in FastAPI that agents often get wrong: field_validator, model_validator, discriminated unions, computed_field and response_model filtering.

results.title: FastAPI WebSockets with token auth and broadcast, tested with TestClient
results.summary: FastAPI WebSocket endpoint that authenticates via query token, rejects with a close code and broadcasts to connected clients; tested with TestClient.websocket_connect.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints cached with cashews in-memory backend
results.summary: FastAPI routes backed by a cashews mem:// cache with key templates, TTL and explicit invalidation, tested fully offline through httpx ASGITransport.

results.title: FastAPI config via pydantic-settings as a cached dependency
results.summary: Load config from env vars with pydantic-settings, inject it into FastAPI routes through a cached dependency, and test it offline with monkeypatch and dependency_overrides.
